concerns.text: T003 weakens the feature extraction requirement by aggregating metrics into a 'single subject-level Variability_Metric (mean edge SD)', which contradicts dataset.schema.yaml (requiring PCA_Component_1 through 10) and plan.md Complexity Tracking (which mandates PCA to avoid Type II errors).

T006 implements 'phase-shuffled surrogate time-series', which is explicitly rejected in plan.md Complexity Tracking ('Phase-shuffling preserves variance, making the test trivial') in favor of an 'AR Surrogate Null Model'.
T002 fails to implement mandatory checksumming of downloaded data, violating Constitution Principle III ('Datasets MUST be checksummed and the checksum recorded under data/').
